Hi Alice — quick answers inline below to help your team triage:  

1) Encryption at rest / CMK: Yes — audit logs and persistent storage are encrypted at rest. For Dedicated customers we support customer-managed keys via KMS; we can provide the key-rotation and key-access controls in the appendix.

2) Data deletion / validation: We provide standard contract language for deletion windows and a deletion certificate on request (deletion job logs + verification checksum). For Dedicated deployments we can also schedule a one-time validated wipe if required.

If you'd like, Marissa can join a 15-minute call to answer any control-level follow-ups (e.g., sample evidence locations, control IDs mapping). Here are two times I'm available: Fri 8/21 10:00–10:30 or Mon 8/24 09:00–09:30 PT — tell me what works and I'll book.
